reason_for_metadata_first: The #503 tree contains large numbers of Central Asian coins unrelated to the Chinese-style square-hole cash tradition. Raw gallery/detail HTML is needed for complete scope review; original images can then be acquired selectively.
identity_rules: Zeno record ID is an ExternalRecord ID, not a specimen ID.
A record appearing in multiple category snapshots does not create an additional specimen.
Parent and child category counts are never summed as independent records.
resume_rules: Cached successful gallery/detail HTML is reused by default.
--refresh is explicit and a failed refresh preserves the prior successful file.
HTML and images are written to temporary files before replacement.
Fetch failures remain in manifests and do not stop unrelated records/categories where continuation is possible.
completion_rules: #503 tree census is complete only when all reachable direct subcategories are visited or explicit categoryFetchFailures account for gaps.
#2141 and #795 must be present in the #503 tree or be separately audited.
#795 remains independently complete at 254 observed source records and is preserved as a forced coverage snapshot.
